about_description: Located in the heart of Minho, Quinta Flores is a haven of peace and tranquility, where Minho tradition meets modern comfort. Our family property has been welcoming guests since 1985, offering an authentic experience of Portuguese rural life.
about_description_2: With lush gardens, traditional vineyards, and a breathtaking view over the Lima Valley, our local accommodation is the perfect place to relax and recharge.
room_standard_desc: Cozy room with garden view, equipped with double bed, private bathroom, and balcony.
room_superior_desc: Spacious room with valley view, king-size bed, sitting area, and bathroom with bathtub.
room_family_desc: Large apartment with two bedrooms, complete living room and equipped kitchen, ideal for families.
testimonial_1: Quinta Flores exceeded all our expectations. The place is beautiful, the rooms are spotless, and the breakfast is delicious with regional products. We will definitely return!
testimonial_2: It was our second stay and it was just as good as the first. The staff's attention is exceptional and we loved the suggested tours in the region. We recommend it!
testimonial_3: Perfect place to experience authentic Portuguese countryside. The owners are lovely and made us feel at home. The pool area is fantastic with amazing views.
